label: Pumitamig + Chemo Objective Response Rate in 1L NSCLC (ROSETTA Lung-02, Phase 2)
source: BioNTech/BMS ASCO 2026 presentation (abstract #8513), May 30 2026; BioNTech Q2 2026 corporate update, Aug 4 2026
contestNote: Interim data from 40 response-evaluable patients (April 13, 2026 cutoff); 57.1% ORR in non-squamous NSCLC, 68.4% in squamous NSCLC, 100% disease control rate. Small interim sample; Phase 2/3 randomized comparison ongoing. BioNTech's Aug 4 2026 Q2 update additionally reported a 47.6% confirmed ORR in PD-L1-negative 1L NSCLC patients, showing robust activity across PD-L1 expression levels.
deltaNote: Pumitamig (BNT327) is a PD-L1×VEGF-A bispecific, not an mRNA vaccine per se, but a centerpiece of BioNTech's combined mRNA/immuno-oncology pipeline; now the subject of four registrational programs in lung cancer

label: BNT116 mRNA Lung Cancer Vaccine Objective Response Rate (Phase 1 + cemiplimab)
source: BioNTech Q1 2026 Corporate Update; LuCa-MERIT-1 trial
contestNote: Phase 1 data from 20 patients; small sample size; Phase 2/3 required to confirm. Disease control rate: 80%. Combination with anti-PD-1 cemiplimab makes it difficult to attribute benefit exclusively to the mRNA vaccine component.
delta: First shared-antigen mRNA vaccine to show tumor shrinkage in lung cancer
deltaNote: BNT116 targets six tumor-associated antigens (CLDN6, KK-LC1, MAGE-A3, MAGE-A4, MAGE-C1, PRAME); active in NSCLC where standard-of-care checkpoint inhibitors alone achieve ~20-30% ORR
